purpose: Test whether historical public availability of SEC MIDAS quarterly vintages can be independently reconstructed before any performance use.
sources: SEC Market Structure Data Downloads page
SEC Market Structure Data Downloads RSS feed
pass_rule: Every target vintage must have a dataset-page link and an RSS item containing an explicit publication timestamp that can be associated with that vintage.
fail_closed_rule: A current page Last-Updated field, current HTTP Last-Modified header, filename chronology, or inferred quarter date is never treated as historical publication time.
